correctness.rationale: The published percolated Grover trapped-state theorem exactly covers the specified full-support dynamics. In the bipartite punctured cube trapped states are the normalized undirected cycle space, giving arc absorption (1+R)/2. A rank-d-1 Kron-complement update, symmetric scalar resistance and explicit Boolean heat-kernel differences produce every binomial term; fixed-depth beta asymptotics yield the asserted coefficient. The 27 independently grounded finite-Laplacian solves and four actual percolated density-channel simulations reproduced from verify.py agree within 6.83e-15. Numerical experiments are supporting checks, not the general proof.

value.rationale: A single-sink, single-arc absorption law as a function of initial Hamming depth is a direct natural quantitative gap in the foundational studies of percolated Grover walks. The closed all-dimensional rational formula and sharp \(k\)-dependent \(d^{-2k}\) correction establish how a local sink perturbs global trapping across high-dimensional networks. This is a motivated structural classification, not an arbitrary small numerical case, generic algorithm reapplication, or known cube example.
